spans.s:
mfn. (-णः-णा or -णी-णं)
Nourishing, fattening, nutritious.
m. (-णः)
A kind of sweetmeat made of sugar, milk, spices, &c. fried in Ghee, and powdered with coarse sugar or treacle.
E.
वृहि to increase, and ल्युट् or युच् aff.

mfn. (-यः-या-यं)
To be nourished, what ought to or may be.
E.
वृहि to grow, अनीयर् aff.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Grown, increased.
2 Cherished, nourished.
n. (-तं)
The roar of elephants.
E.
वृहि to grow or increase, aff. क्त.

n. (-न्तं)
1 The footstalk of a leaf or fruit.
2 The nipple.
3 The stand of a water jar.
E.
वृञ् to choose, क्त aff., and नुम् augment.

mf. (-कः-की)
The egg-plant, (Solanum melongena.)
E.
वृन्त footstalk, and अक to go, aff. अच्.

f. (-ता)
A medicinal plant, (Wrightea antidysenterica.)
E.
वृन्त a stalk, इतच् aff.

mfn. (-न्दः-न्दा-न्दं)
All, many.
n. (-न्दं)
A heap, a multitude, a quantity, an aggregation.
f. (-न्दा)
Holy basil, (Ocymum sanctum).
E.
वृण to please, aff. दन, form irr.

mfn. (-रः-रा-रं)
1 Beautiful, handsome, pleasing.
2 Eminent, reputable.
E.
वृन्द a quantity, and आरक aff. implying pre-eminence.

mfn. (-कः-का-कं)
1 Handsome, agreeable, pleasing.
2 Best, excellent, chief.
3 Much, great.
4 Reputable, respectable, eminent.
m. (-कः)
1 A deity, an immortal.
2 A chief, the head or leader of a crowd or herd, &c.
E.
वृन्द a heap, and आरकन् aff., implying pre-eminence.

mfn. (-ष्ठः-ष्ठा-ष्ठं)
Very beautiful or charming, very excellent or elevated, very reputable or venerable.
E.
वृन्दारक chief, excellent, वृन्द substituted, and इष्ठन् aff. of the irr. super.; also with ईयसुन् the same, वृन्दीयस.

mfn. (-यान्-यसी-यः)
Very eminent or excellent.
E.
see the last.
